attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: claim-status-management-reporting
steps:
  - id: receive_report_request
    op: receive_request
    params:
      channel: api
      required_fields:
        - date_range_start
        - date_range_end
        - audience
        - report_variant
        - filters
    output: report_request

  - id: authenticate_user
    op: authenticate
    params:
      token_source: report_request.auth_token
      required_permissions:
        - claim_report:read
    output: authenticated_user

  - id: resolve_tenant
    op: resolve_tenant_context
    params:
      user: authenticated_user
    output: tenant_context

  - id: read_employer_summary
    op: database_query
    params:
      tenant_db: tenant_context.database
      query_type: employer_summary
      date_range_start: report_request.date_range_start
      date_range_end: report_request.date_range_end
      filters: report_request.filters
    output: employer_summary_data

  - id: read_activity_data
    op: database_query
    params:
      tenant_db: tenant_context.database
      query_type: activity
      categories:
        - FCM
        - IME
      date_range_start: report_request.date_range_start
      date_range_end: report_request.date_range_end
      filters: report_request.filters
    output: activity_data

  - id: read_medical_data
    op: database_query
    params:
      tenant_db: tenant_context.database
      query_type: medical
      date_range_start: report_request.date_range_start
      date_range_end: report_request.date_range_end
      filters: report_request.filters
    output: medical_data

  - id: read_litigation_data
    op: database_query
    params:
      tenant_db: tenant_context.database
      query_type: litigation
      date_range_start: report_request.date_range_start
      date_range_end: report_request.date_range_end
      filters: report_request.filters
    output: litigation_data

  - id: read_lost_time_data
    op: database_query
    params:
      tenant_db: tenant_context.database
      query_type: lost_time
      date_range_start: report_request.date_range_start
      date_range_end: report_request.date_range_end
      filters: report_request.filters
    output: lost_time_data

  - id: read_incident_data
    op: database_query
    params:
      tenant_db: tenant_context.database
      query_type: incident
      date_range_start: report_request.date_range_start
      date_range_end: report_request.date_range_end
      filters: report_request.filters
    output: incident_data

  - id: aggregate_report
    op: aggregate
    params:
      sources:
        - employer_summary_data
        - activity_data
        - medical_data
        - litigation_data
        - lost_time_data
        - incident_data
      report_variant: report_request.report_variant
      audience: report_request.audience
      date_range_start: report_request.date_range_start
      date_range_end: report_request.date_range_end
    output: unified_report

  - id: format_report_html
    op: render_template
    params:
      template_engine: html
      template_selector: report_request.report_variant
      audience: report_request.audience
      data: unified_report
      output_format: html
      print_optimized: true
    output: formatted_report

  - id: return_report
    op: respond
    params:
      content_type: text/html
      body: formatted_report
      status: 200
